subject: A legitimacy crisis on the court
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Alexandria Ocasio-Cortez for Congress
body:
#
A Supreme Court watchdog group reported that SCOTUS Justices have received at least $4.7 million in gifts over the past 20 years.1
Justice Clarence Thomas _alone_ likely received $4.2 million in gifts.2 Some were from billionaire GOP megadonors; others were from folks who had cases heard by the Court.
**The Supreme Court is in a legitimacy crisis**. So yesterday, Alexandria joined Ranking Member Jamie Raskin to announce legislation that would bar SCOTUS Justices from receiving gifts valued at over $50.
If Congress fails to hold the Supreme Court accountable, it will send a dangerous signal to the special interests trying to buy them off that **their actions are fair game**.
[This level of corruption is shocking by any standard of a functioning democracy. Will you make a $5 contribution today so that AOC can keep fighting to ensure no one — no matter how rich or powerful — is above the law?](https://act.ocasiocortez.com/go/14659?c0=aoc-email-20240612.zDIUDh&refcode=em20240612-6623-P_FND_CTR_HDL&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1&akid=6623%2E2526796%2ECqGall)

In solidarity,
Team AOC

name: Elizabeth Warren
subject: This is obscene
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Warren for Senate
body:
| | | [ ](https://act.elizabethwarren.com/go/216?t=3&akid=2215%2E4032634%2EG_iG60)
---
While he was President, Trump passed a tax law that gave wealthy people and corporations $2 trillion in tax breaks. That’s trillion — with a T. This law allowed American billionaires to pay an average federal tax rate that's far less than what teachers, nurses, and everyday workers pay. And it allowed companies that made $40 billion in profits to pay zero in federal income taxes. Yep, zero. But wait, there’s more: According to new reporting from the Washington Post, as Trump is courting wealthy donors for his 2024 campaign, he’s promising them _even more_ tax handouts in return. Giant corporations are going in on the deal, too, loading up Republican campaign accounts with cash with the expectation that they’ll get even more tax cuts. And it just so happens that Trump's planned tax cuts would give the largest corporations an estimated $48 billion break. This is obscene. Look, I’ve fought my entire career to make our economy fairer for the middle class. I’ve learned that it’s not too hard to answer who the government is looking out for. The answer is written in the tax code, and Republicans are making their answer loud and clear. While Trump and the Republicans fight to make rich and powerful people and companies even more rich and powerful, I'll keep fighting alongside President Biden to get the wealthy and well-connected to pay a fair share — so we can expand opportunity for all. We’ve already started to tackle this by passing my minimum tax on massive corporations that were paying $0 in taxes, and to provide more funding to the IRS to strengthen enforcement against corporations and wealthy tax cheats. But there’s still more we’ve got to do. I’m campaigning for my wealth tax on fortunes greater than $50 million — which would generate huge amounts of revenue totaling at least $3 trillion over a decade — as well as my plan to end lobbying as we know it so big money won’t have so much power in Washington. President Biden has also proposed a minimum tax of 25% for billionaires — and he's proposed to increase my corporate minimum tax from 15% to 21%. This would generate trillions of dollars for our country that would otherwise just stay in the pockets of billionaires and pump up big corporations’ balance sheets. Look: billionaire donors and corporate interests are spending big this year to try to elect Trump and his GOP allies in November — and reap big rewards for _themselves_ in the years to come. We can pass legislation to make the billionaires and corporations pay their fair share and reap big rewards for _all of us_ in the years to come: Creating affordable child care and paid family leave, making investments in affordable housing and health care, funding our public schools and transportation...the list goes on. **They’ve got money and power. But the number of people that make up our grassroots movement is powerful, too. We can beat them if we fight side by side, one grassroots donation at a time, to pass this legislation that will make our economy fairer for the middle class.**

[**I’m able to stay in these fights because supporters like you chip in whatever and whenever they can to strengthen our fight for these policies. Can you help grow our grassroots campaign and support my re-election with a donation of $28 or any amount?**](https://act.elizabethwarren.com/go/2243?amount=28&t=8&akid=2215%2E4032634%2EG_iG60)

The Democrat donors were brave to attend; they'd been fiercely pressured not to. One business represented there had spent $250 million defending itself against the SEC. They can't afford four more years of the policies being set by the Biden administration. I say the administration and not Biden himself because, let's face it, _the lights are on but nobody's home._

Security was fierce. The city police department and county sheriff's office maintained a perimeter three blocks out, and the USSS controlled the house. The liberal media, looking a little forlorn, were camped out on a corner down the street. I waved at them "bigly" as we were let in! We'd heard rumors of protestors and a giant inflatable chicken, but nothing really materialized. Instead, hundreds of Trump supporters came out. It was EPIC!

First came the photos. During the best events, a staffer calls out guests' names, so President Trump knows who's walking in next. Harmeet (a Trump attorney of several years) was in front of us, and he took both her hands and joked, "Nah, I don't know this one at all!" He has a way of making people feel comfortable. The first time I ever met him, he walked across the room, shook my hand and said, "Absolutely beautiful." Impossible to go wrong with that! Now, a few times later, he laughed and said, "It's that beautiful woman again!" He and Solomon were able to handle a bit of business while discussing California, Oregon, and other things. The USSS even let us get some candid shots with Solomon's cell phone, which doesn't usually happen.

David Sacks and J.D. Vance introduced Trump before his speech. RNC Chair Michael Whatley and the upper echelon of the campaign team were there. Gov. Burgum from ND was there. I have to say, the President was in fine form. He was sharp as a tack, FUNNY, and definitely on a roll. The setting was intimate, so his speech was more like a discussion with the audience - a far different vibe from a rally. They had two more CA events scheduled for the next day, then two in Las Vegas.

Solomon and I came back with several projects going at once, and these events help us network and plan. We're volunteers when it comes to politics. Our **Worldwide Freedom Initiative** under [**Republicans Overseas**](https://sptr.eocampaign1.com/f/a/iWp8nJarrmsAq2_t631z4w~~/AAAHUQA~/RgRoTPk1P0UgYzNmZWIwYWFmZmMyZTNkMGZkMmQzZjVmMjM0NGU5NTlEIGh0dHBzOi8vcmVwdWJsaWNhbnNvdmVyc2Vhcy5jb20vVwVzcGNldUIKZlE1dGpmXE8ULFIUZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb21YBAAAX2M~) is currently set for its second year. This time, we'll gather right and center-right world leaders together in Hungary. This is our direct pushback against Davos/the WEF.

2\. The [**Oregon Conservative Caucus**](https://sptr.eocampaign1.com/f/a/E7aI3o_9qtyoknWizz3NBg~~/AAAHUQA~/RgRoTPk1P0UgYjg5ODU3OTQ0Yzc2MzhkMzM3ZWUyNmE3MzMzZjFmNWJEKWh0dHBzOi8vd3d3Lm9yZWdvbmNvbnNlcnZhdGl2ZWNhdWN1cy5jb20vVwVzcGNldUIKZlE1dGpmXE8ULFIUZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb21YBAAAX2M~) nonprofit is about to launch! name: Cristen Wohlgemuth
subject: Fight Back Against Biden's Policies
body:
Our constitutional freedoms and energy independence are under attack

| | | [](https://e.youramerica.news/rd/9z2zn9ns0fvnlb5kl0qlgpkjjh0qhhoqlp1oed909c8_rp22sh2s8i6ep30s9jm4p70chh2bs)
---
| | Dear Friend of Liberty,

I'm writing to share urgent news with you. Our constitutional freedoms and energy independence are under attack from the Biden Administration's aggressive policies. These policies are crippling our energy industry, stifling economic growth, and threatening livelihoods across the nation.

These policies are driven by people who want to shut down small-scale miners and independent energy producers. As you probably know, the Biden Administration has filled key positions with radical "green" activists who are determined to undercut and kill energy production in America:
* Vice President Kamala Harris--who says, "We know we cannot achieve health justice, economic justice, racial justice, or educational justice without environmental justice."
* Secretary of the Interior Deb Haaland--a former far-left member of Congress who also participated in the protests against the Dakota Access Pipeline in 2016, which turned violent.
* Bureau of Land Management Director Tracy Stone-Manning--who previously worked for Earth First, which is famous for acts of eco-terrorism and arson.
* Beverly Wright--who serves on the White House Environmental Justice Advisory Council and equates energy production and fossil fuels with racism.

Small-scale miners, and independent energy producers, are suffering due to these overreaching regulations.

Almost every day, we're hearing from more and more Americans who desperately need our help in defending their rights as the government overreaches to shut down their businesses and make their land unusable for the purposes they need to feed their families.

We've won key cases against Deb Haaland to overturn her agency's attempts to shut down mining operations and refuse small family businesses the right to operate on land they own.

But we need to do more. That's why we are preparing to launch MSLF's new **Center for American Prosperity & Energy**.

With your help, MSLF's **Center for American Prosperity & Energy** will have talented attorneys working in-house, whose full-time job is pursuing natural resources litigation. At the same time, it will also utilize the consistent and effective messaging operation needed for nationwide public outreach and education.

Keep in mind that we represent our clients at zero legal cost because no American should be denied justice. And the cases we take on can set legal precedent and put the government back in its place.

As you know, we are a public-interest law firm. We take no handouts from the federal government. We rely solely on the support of friends like you to ensure that our remarkable team of litigators has the resources needed to win in court.

That's why I'm asking you to send a generous gift to help us raise the $301,000 needed to successfully launch MSLF's new Center for American Prosperity & Energy this year. And here's another reason to let me hear from you today.

**Our MSLF Board of Directors feels so strongly about the threat to natural resources producers, that they 're issuing the following matching gift challenge:**

** For every contribution we receive by June 14th, our Board members will match every gift--dollar for dollar--up to $90,000. That means that any gift you send today will be worth twice as much.**

Would you please help us meet this matching gift challenge by giving a gift of $50, $100, $250, even $500 or $1,000 or more, and allowing our Board to match it?

Your matched contribution will help us deploy all the weapons in our legal arsenal--all locked and loaded and ready to defend our property rights, mining, and drilling rights, and every right enshrined in the Constitution.

If you're as angry as I am about what Biden has done to energy production and small businesses, this is your chance to fight back.

[Click here to make your gift today and have it matched by our Board.](https://e.youramerica.news/rd/9z2zadt955jb8l0jq1eleq81gupoch25eo4qd64lnng_rp22sh2s8i6ep30s9jm4p70chh2bs)

Thank you so much for your generosity.

Cristen Wohlgemuth
President & CEO
Mountain States Legal Foundation
---

Your America

body:
One of our most popular courses has been about a famous British author — C.S. Lewis.

This sponsored message from Pro Life Update is on behalf of Hillsdale College
[](http://e.prolifeupdate.com/rd/9z2zls3bl7agaqikn4kjk3mnbnth1tlu2r8l7smn76g_rp22sh2s8i6ep30s9jmcpr4chh2bs) Dear Fellow American, I hope you are having a fine day so far. Thanks for opening my email. Today, I'm writing to let you know about a special offer for you from Hillsdale College, a private, fiercely independent, conservative college located in south-central Michigan where I work. You may have heard of us on talk radio, social media, YouTube, podcasts, or even on _Fox News _because of our educational outreach efforts on behalf of liberty--like our free online courses. _ _ And though we're best known for educating Americans about the Constitution and founding principles through these free courses, one of our most popular courses has been about a famous _British_ author--C.S. Lewis. In fact, our free online course, **"[ An Introduction to C.S. Lewis: Writings and Significance,](http://e.prolifeupdate.com/rd/9z2zldvp06kfou2j1m1s6vmc6hs5me4eervdrfs3e9o_rp22sh2s8i6ep30s9jmcpr4chh2bs)" **has more than 500,000 people enrolled. C.S. Lewis was a war hero, a bright light during some very dark hours in world history. He is one of my absolute favorite authors because... ...While you may know him for his landmark _Chronicles of Narnia_ series, he was also a brilliant philosopher, writer, and Christian apologist. That's why we decided to develop this online course. Since launching **"[An Introduction to C.S. Lewis: Writings and Significance](http://e.prolifeupdate.com/rd/9z2zm5ap3r6h7bqc2qem587khcbf7d65qqu5v4b8tuo_rp22sh2s8i6ep30s9jmcpr4chh2bs)," **we've received an outpouring of thanks for offering a course that covers the breadth and scope of Lewis' writings. So, I'm pleased to announce that the C.S. Lewis course is available on DVD for your home library. You can also give it as a gift or use it in a small group, such as a Bible study or book club. We only made a few of these special sets, so get this premium edition of **"[An Introduction to C.S. Lewis: Writings and Significance](http://e.prolifeupdate.com/rd/9z2zctuc6715hqv7onm4tfvct3q4l8kaflrb435m24g_rp22sh2s8i6ep30s9jmcpr4chh2bs)"** on DVD today. Given how popular this course is, the DVD box set won't last long. name: Dr. Robert Jeffress
subject: Are you ready for the end times?
body:
http://paracom.paramountcommunication.com/p/vWfG1ZpWNz

Have you ever wondered if things could return to God's original
plan?

http://paracom.paramountcommunication.com/p/oWfG1ZpWNz

Hello
Friend,

Take a
moment to look around. It's like we're living out Romans 1:25 -
trading the truth of God for a lie and focusing on earthly things
rather than our Creator.

Have you
ever wondered if things could return to God's original plan?

I want to
remind you, Friend, that this chaotic time is fleeting. The
shadows will fade, and a new day will dawn. The King of Kings,
our Savior, will return.

That's
the heart of Revelation.

Each day
on this earth shapes us for what's to come - a grand finale.
Amidst today's messiness and uncertainty, remember the promise
that our story's end is already secured, regardless of the
present turmoil or future darkness.

Revelation intricately unveils where our stories lead.

It's a
captivating book filled with symbols, creatures, and events yet
to unfold. But remember Revelation 1:3 - there's a blessing for
those who read, listen, and follow its words because the time is
near.

This
isn't just a prophecy; it's a blessing-filled journey.

Revelation isn't just about revealing future events; it's about
revealing Jesus Christ.

When
Jesus came as a man, His divine brilliance was veiled by
humanity. It's like dimming a lamp's light. But when He returns,
that veil will lift, and we'll see His true glory. That's
Revelation's essence.

As the
great reveal approaches, I'm here to guide you and your loved
ones through the remarkable events preceding the revelation of
our King.

In my
brand-new book, Mysteries of the End Times: 5 Truths About God's
Future Plans, I tackle five common questions about the end times.
We'll delve into:

1.
America's Fate: Will America stand for Christ or fall for the
Antichrist?
2. The
Day of the Lord: How should we live in anticipation of this
apocalyptic event?
3. The
Marriage of the Lamb: What unfolds before and after the rapture?
4. Gog
and Magog: How can we honor God in our lives amid their
appearance?
5. The
Tree of Life: What's the significance of this tree in the New
Jerusalem?

Understanding these mysteries will anchor you in hope, bolster
your trust in God's promises, and equip you to share with the
unsure.

In
addition to this new book, I would like to share with you "The
Major Characters of the End Times," as a token of my gratitude
for your support. This full-color, large print booklet introduces
key players during the rapture, tribulation, second coming, and
final judgment - vital for understanding the grand narrative.

I would
like to send you my brand-new book Mysteries of the End Times: 5
Truths About God's Future Plans and my brand-new resource "The
Major Characters of the End Times' as a thank you for your
generous support of $10 or more to the ministry of Pathway to
Victory.

Make your
generous gift here:
https://secure.ptv.org/mysteries-of-the-end-times-generous-gift-1-dr-robert-jeffress

Pathway
to Victory is committed to equipping believers with biblical
teaching and reaching the unsaved by spreading the Good News of
Jesus Christ through the most effective means available: radio,
television, digital, and print. Your gifts fuel that important
work and enable people worldwide to experience an intimate walk
with Christ. Thank you for your faithful support.

May our
study of Revelation prepare, strengthen, and inspire you. Come
quickly, Lord Jesus.

Sharing
the Truth of God's Word,

Dr.
Robert Jeffress
Senior
Pastor, First Baptist Dallas

subject: Stop the Federal Government's Power Grab
body:
Everyone should play by the same rules.

| | | [](http://e.1600daily.com/rd/9z2z37d8djj4dnnh7prru88a9q3eg3jf1nkmjableco_rp22sh2s8i6ep30s9jm1oj4clh2bs)
---
| | Dear Friend of Liberty,

Everyone should play by the same rules. That's the basic idea of fairness that most Americans understand. When it suits them, the federal government loves to hold people accountable to its rules, but the feds hate it when they're forced to obey state law.

Now, we're seeing this play out in front of our very eyes in the case of water rights. And it should concern every single American citizen.

That's why I'm emailing you today. [](http://e.1600daily.com/rd/9z2zatmlvc98562t8e2k5h86geo9ejvtkl2go4uqm5g_rp22sh2s8i6ep30s9jm1oj4clh2bs)
For decades, it has been well-settled and unambiguous law that stockwater rights on National Forest lands are subject to state law--not a federal whim. These rights are traditionally held by ranchers who are grazing on forest lands and need a place to water their stock, like cattle or sheep.

In Idaho, the law requires that anyone who has such rights put them to "beneficial use" by watering their own livestock. But now, the US government is trying to seize control of stockwater rights away from the state by declaring its law unconstitutional.

If the federal government is successful in this effort, it would significantly threaten the livelihood of Idaho's ranchers. But it's even worse than that.

This case could very well go beyond the borders of Idaho because if the federal government wins, it could repeat this same action in states across the American West. That not only presents a significant danger to the ability of western states to govern themselves, but it would set a dangerous precedent that would allow the federal government to reach even further into the lives of private citizens like you.

Mountain States Legal Foundation is not taking this lightly. After the US government filed a lawsuit against Idaho back in June, our legal team sprung into action to intervene on behalf of ranchers Paul Nettleton, Tim Lowry, and Don Pickett--along with the Idaho Farm Bureau Federation.

Now, I'm asking you to support their critical fight by signing our petition today.

We must show the federal government that we are serious. That's why your voice is needed to tell these bureaucrats that they cannot get away with disobeying state laws and infringing on the rights of American citizens.

As Samuel Adams once said, "It does not take a majority to prevail... but rather an irate, tireless minority, keen on setting brushfires for freedom in the minds of men."

Please light the brushfires of freedom--and tell the federal government that enough is enough--by signing the petition right now using this secure link: [https://mslegal.org/subscribe/idaho-stockwater-petition/](http://e.1600daily.com/rd/9z2zmj8tb3c7angkncc1990ql79ssf2ef390shvn028_rp22sh2s8i6ep30s9jm1oj4clh2bs)

Thank you,

For Liberty!

Cristen Wohlgemuth
President & CEO
Mountain States Legal Foundation

name: Cristen Wohlgemuth
subject: Stand Up for Energy Independence
body:
Our constitutional freedoms and energy independence are under attack

| | | [](http://post.spmailtechnol.com/f/a/EmFYSL8nYOlRqZTmv0nNpA~~/AARclAA~)
---
| | Dear Friend of Liberty,

I'm writing to share urgent news with you. Our constitutional freedoms and energy independence are under attack from the Biden Administration's aggressive policies. These policies are crippling our energy industry, stifling economic growth, and threatening livelihoods across the nation.

These policies are driven by people who want to shut down small-scale miners and independent energy producers. As you probably know, the Biden Administration has filled key positions with radical "green" activists who are determined to undercut and kill energy production in America:
* Vice President Kamala Harris--who says, "We know we cannot achieve health justice, economic justice, racial justice, or educational justice without environmental justice."
* Secretary of the Interior Deb Haaland--a former far-left member of Congress who also participated in the protests against the Dakota Access Pipeline in 2016, which turned violent.
* Bureau of Land Management Director Tracy Stone-Manning--who previously worked for Earth First, which is famous for acts of eco-terrorism and arson.
* Beverly Wright--who serves on the White House Environmental Justice Advisory Council and equates energy production and fossil fuels with racism.

Small-scale miners, and independent energy producers, are suffering due to these overreaching regulations.

Almost every day, we're hearing from more and more Americans who desperately need our help in defending their rights as the government overreaches to shut down their businesses and make their land unusable for the purposes they need to feed their families.

We've won key cases against Deb Haaland to overturn her agency's attempts to shut down mining operations and refuse small family businesses the right to operate on land they own.

But we need to do more. That's why we are preparing to launch MSLF's new **Center for American Prosperity & Energy**.

With your help, MSLF's **Center for American Prosperity & Energy** will have talented attorneys working in-house, whose full-time job is pursuing natural resources litigation. At the same time, it will also utilize the consistent and effective messaging operation needed for nationwide public outreach and education.

Keep in mind that we represent our clients at zero legal cost because no American should be denied justice. And the cases we take on can set legal precedent and put the government back in its place.

As you know, we are a public-interest law firm. We take no handouts from the federal government. We rely solely on the support of friends like you to ensure that our remarkable team of litigators has the resources needed to win in court.

That's why I'm asking you to send a generous gift to help us raise the $301,000 needed to successfully launch MSLF's new Center for American Prosperity & Energy this year. And here's another reason to let me hear from you today.

**Our MSLF Board of Directors feels so strongly about the threat to natural resources producers, that they 're issuing the following matching gift challenge:**

** For every contribution we receive by June 14th, our Board members will match every gift--dollar for dollar--up to $90,000. That means that any gift you send today will be worth twice as much.**

Would you please help us meet this matching gift challenge by giving a gift of $50, $100, $250, even $500 or $1,000 or more, and allowing our Board to match it?

Your matched contribution will help us deploy all the weapons in our legal arsenal--all locked and loaded and ready to defend our property rights, mining, and drilling rights, and every right enshrined in the Constitution.

If you're as angry as I am about what Biden has done to energy production and small businesses, this is your chance to fight back.

[Click here to make your gift today and have it matched by our Board.](http://post.spmailtechnol.com/f/a/EmFYSL8nYOlRqZTmv0nNpA~~/AARclAA~)

Thank you so much for your generosity.

Cristen Wohlgemuth
President & CEO
Mountain States Legal Foundation
---

Conservative Broadcast
---

body:
Two of the three Republicans who betrayed pro-lifers just lost their primaries...
Dear Pro-Life Friend,

You never hear when pro-lifers win from the pro-abortion media.

But thanks to your support, pro-lifers just had some incredible victories during South Carolina’s primary elections yesterday!

Last night, **_TWO_** South Carolina Senate Republicans who betrayed pro-lifers in stonewalling our _Life at Conception Act_ which would have ended abortion in the Palmetto state, just LOST in their primaries.

_And a** _THIRD_** one will face a runoff in two weeks!_

Media elites are FURIOUS!

You see, after a group of South Carolina Republicans joined forces with Planned Parenthood to KILL our _Life at Conception Act in 2023, The New York Times_ did everything they could to paint these traitors as heroes.

[](https://studentsforlifeofamerica.cmail20.com/t/j-l-gekto-duchtdja-y/)
These Republicans that pro-lifers just beat are among the same “Sister Senators” this headline posted by _The New York Times_ not long ago is referring to.

They’re the same women who our students delivered “Grow a Spine” awards to, asking them to stand up to _Planned Parenthood,_ and who laughed and called us names from the floor of the Senate (here's the photo proof).
[](https://studentsforlifeofamerica.cmail20.com/t/j-l-gekto-duchtdja-j/)
But as of last night, one of them, Senator Penry Gustafson, was beaten very badly.

And after _Students for Life Action’s_ field team knocked on 1,134 doors in her district, another one, Senator Sandy Senn, lost by only 31 votes!

With two of these three **_GONE_** – _and pro-lifers gearing to kick the third to the curb as well_ – we’ll have a real chance at finally passing our _Life at Conception Act_ in South Carolina in 2025.

**_So, who’s laughing now?_**

But even after our victories last night, we can’t celebrate just yet . . .

We have to put everything we’ve got into this runoff election to make sure voters in Republican Senator Katrina Shealy’s district know how she’s stabbed pro-life voters and preborn babies in the back.

Pro-Life Friend, these victories are going to help us take some BIG steps forward in our effort to save lives.

And they’ll also show national GOP types who are considering weakening the RNC platform on Life what a disaster that would be for them in their primaries – _and in November!_

**[So, would you please make your most generous contribution of $250, $100, $50, or $25 to _Students for Life Action’s_ election efforts so we can deal the final blow to the Abortion Lobby in South Carolina](https://studentsforlifeofamerica.cmail20.com/t/j-l-gekto-duchtdja-i/)?**

Thank you for everything you do for Life.

For Life,

Kristan Hawkins
President, _Students for Life Action_

body:
Your daily rundown of REAL news for REAL Coloradans.
| | | | [](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
---
**PRESENTED BY[ROCKYMOUNTAINVOICE.COM](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
| | Hi there,
This is the Mountain Minute for Thursday, June 13, 2024.
- Heidi Ganahl
---
|
---
| | **TODAY'S TOP STORIES**
---
**[Tucker Carlson tour to stop Sept. 6 in Colorado Springs with Tulsi Gabbard](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** [ROCKY MOUNTAIN VOICE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
[](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
Tucker Carlson, the former Fox News conservative primetime show host, will make [Colorado Springs](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) a destination this fall.

Following stops in Phoenix, Ariz., and Anaheim, Calif., to open the [Tucker Carlson Live Tour](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.), Carlson will visit Colorado Springs on Sept. 6 at the Broadmoor World Arena.

The stop will be his only appearance in Colorado. The announcement on his website indicates [Tulsi Gabbard](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) - a military veteran, once a congresswoman and Democratic candidate for President, and now conservative commentator with a potential bid for vice president - will appear with Carlson in Colorado, and the announcement reads that Carlson "and friends" will appear "from coast to coast" on his first live tour. During a four-day, four-event stretch including the Colorado stop, Carlson will also appear with Russell Brand, Vivek Ramaswamy and Glenn Beck.
**[READ MORE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
|
---
**[Cooper: Is signature verification of mail-in ballots valid?](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** BY BOB COOPER, [ROCKY MOUNTAIN VOICE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) | COMMENTARY
_All mail-in voting systems use a process called signature verification to verify the person voting by mail is the voter registered to vote. In Colorado this process is based on comparing the signature on the outer ballot envelope with the digital signature images in a database called SCORE._
_This is the only procedure to verify the identity of the voter before that ballot is counted. Once a signature passes signature verification, the envelope is opened, ballots are sent to be counted and envelopes are stored in a separate container. The voter is no longer associated with their votes on the ballot.___
**[READ MORE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
|
---
**[Guns, deepfakes and occupancy limits: 16 new Colorado laws go into effect in July](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** [FOX31 DENVER](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
* Several new laws from the 2024 Colorado legislative session, including significant changes to occupancy, bias-motivated crimes, and firearm regulations, will take effect on July 1. Some examples below:
* [House Bill 24-1007](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) removes limits on the number of unrelated individuals living together.
* [Senate Bill 24-189](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) expands the definition of bias-motivated crimes to include gender identity and expression.
* [Senate Bill 24-131](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) introduces a ban on carrying firearms in designated sensitive spaces such as state legislative buildings, courthouses, and their parking lots.
* [House Bill 24-1147](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) mandates the disclosure of artificial intelligence-generated deepfake images and videos used in political campaigns to ensure transparency.
* [House Bill 24-1150](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) criminalizes the act of falsely representing presidential electors.

**[READ MORE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
|
---
**[What's on my ballot? In University of Colorado regent election, only one primary race is opposed](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** [ROCKY MOUNTAIN VOICE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
* The primary ballot for the [University of Colorado Board of Regents](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) features only one contested race for the Democrats and none for the Republicans.
* The Board consists of nine regents who serve six-year staggered terms, representing each of Colorado's congressional districts, plus one at-large seat. Democrats currently hold a [narrow 5-4 majority](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.).
* District 5 and the At-Large positions are the primary contested seats, with Democratic and Republican [candidates listed](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) for each.
* The [role of the regents](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) includes general supervision and financial oversight of the university, controlling appropriations and university funds.

**[READ MORE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
|
---
**[A call to ban the sale of high-potency THC products in Boulder, amid rising teen mental health concerns](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** [BOULDER REPORTING LAB](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
* Boulder is considering a [ban on high-potency THC products](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) amid concerns about their impact on teen mental health, with a policy review set for August.
* Local health professionals, including addiction counselor Avani Dilger, report [severe mental health issues](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) among teens linked to the increasing potency of THC products.
* The Boulder Cannabis Licensing Advisory Board will discuss [banning THC concentrates](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.), although it's unclear if they have the authority to enforce such a ban.
* Studies and anecdotal evidence link high-potency THC to risks like psychosis and dependency in youth, prompting calls for regulatory action. [Efforts to regulate](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) face challenges from state laws and the cannabis industry, emphasizing the need for better education and preventive strategies.

**[READ MORE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
|
---
**[Colorado to use $826 million in federal funds to expand high-speed internet availability](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** [DENVER7 NEWS](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
* The Biden administration has approved Colorado's plan to utilize over $826 million in federal funds from the Bipartisan Infrastructure Act to [expand high-speed internet](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) across the state.
* The Colorado Broadband Office aims to connect 99% of Colorado households to high-speed broadband [by 2027](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.), focusing on under-served areas.
* The funds will be distributed through [grants to internet service providers](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) to increase access in areas currently lacking sufficient connectivity.
* The public will have the opportunity to comment on draft grant guidelines and project area maps in July, with a [grant application period]() set to open by August or September.

**[READ MORE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
|
---
**[Fed holds interest rates at 23-year high as inflation hits plateau](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** [THE HILL](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
* The Federal Reserve [maintained interest rates](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) at a 23-year high during its latest meeting, keeping rates between 5.25 percent and 5.5 percent amid ongoing efforts to manage inflation.
* Despite significant drops in inflation from its peak two years ago, [concerns persist](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) about the robust labor market and continued price increases, delaying any potential rate cuts. Recent Consumer Price Index (CPI) data [showed prices steady](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) in May but still 3.3 percent higher compared to last year, above the Fed's 2 percent inflation target.
* Traders are now anticipating a [possible rate cut by September](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.), influenced by the latest inflation data, with the Fed's next rate decision also influenced by upcoming elections.
* Federal Reserve Chair Jerome Powell, reappointed by President Biden, faces pressure from various political figures, including Senator Elizabeth Warren, to cut rates to [alleviate economic pressures](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) such as high rent contributing to inflation.

**[READ MORE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
|
---
|
---

There are two opposed races for the state board of education](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** **BY BRIAN PORTER**** | STATE | JUNE 11** _There will be two opposed races, one in each major party, for the Colorado Board of Education, meaning voters in two areas of the state will have decisions to make on their primary ballot._ __
**[Ganahl: Free speech is not the enemy of progress](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** **BY HEIDI GANAHL | COMMENTARY | JUNE 10** _On Wednesday, Colorado Governor Jared Polis signed Senate Bill 24-084 into law, effectively creating what some might call the state 's own Ministry of Truth. The bill, supposedly aimed at preventing the spread of misinformation and disinformation, establishes a partnership between the state attorney general and the Education Department. It's designed to reduce "factually inaccurate data" and "encourage respectful discourse."_
**[What's on my ballot? Reviewing the candidates for U.S. Representative](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** **BY BRIAN PORTER** **| STATE | JUNE 10** _While there will be five Democrat and four Republican positions for U.S. Representative unopposed, many voters around the state will have decisions to make for the office._**[](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**__

I received a death threat from Beijing because I love Liberty, Freedom, and the United States of America. More on that in a minute.

Right now, I want to introduce myself.

_My name is Lily Tang Williams, and I fled Communist China and escaped the evil Communist indoctrination. I'm running for Congress because I fear the country I love is becoming like the country I left._

You see: I was born to illiterate working-class parents in China's western Sichuan province just before Mao's Cultural Revolution. I grew up in extremely poor living conditions with food rationing, social chaos, and indoctrination into Communism. [](http://links.eaglecoalition.com/u/click?_t=e3c9a4cac7f248a39c2a3d920479a441&_m=86ba012b906c4cecaed732d9e585974b&_e=oWlrVfAW3oGSsKLgXDofeHrUx2alsDaKjqu9b56KliFprZV0v4W8qqKwqRGysOtRUK7cMVTX9qWabfI6tFK7M77tq-2PNM1P-S5_HNN5j0ypy4oLdljmvnbs25UNX0UOG4gcrWkM7V9fEZEKJl1GflUxHD_jmcgqrL8e3lGdd4e45ilW3o9gg_whMu78N2L4pPR1ugoTKGwGacft3It4fohsmYoXeuGhqCND92FDPdrbiVOVTijGU-7fKgIxlGuBXin-kR1KM18GkLnh5rcIPdWy5zvumTZJuZLS6LyLDSFEX5ZGUud4de3lN4DglIVeIBkC8ae6ozPcYmJb6klB58O3MaLZKq9sXLswgqR1pIQQI60qi_x6pFDAVLahWK1vkdxXTUy1oAas0xtYClPSm2poICdpWl5iOyLoPyjCYeQtVmUDOUCo9evt_VysoBIE)

At a young age, I learned a hard lesson about surviving in a Communist regime: conform and keep your thoughts private. Do not trust anyone, even your friends.

Everything changed when an American exchange student showed me a pocket-sized version of "The Declaration of Independence." Even with my limited English skills, I could understand most of these words: "We hold these truths to be self-evident...." It's like a lightbulb came on. I had never heard such beautiful words before, and I loved them so much that I spent many hours with my American friend to learn more about these new concepts and America.

_**I had a new dream: I wanted to go to America.**_ [](http://links.eaglecoalition.com/u/click?_t=e3c9a4cac7f248a39c2a3d920479a441&_m=86ba012b906c4cecaed732d9e585974b&_e=oWlrVfAW3oGSsKLgXDofeHrUx2alsDaKjqu9b56KliFprZV0v4W8qqKwqRGysOtRUK7cMVTX9qWabfI6tFK7M77tq-2PNM1P-S5_HNN5j0ypy4oLdljmvnbs25UNX0UOG4gcrWkM7V9fEZEKJl1GflUxHD_jmcgqrL8e3lGdd4e45ilW3o9gg_whMu78N2L4pPR1ugoTKGwGacft3It4fohsmYoXeuGhqCND92FDPdrbiVOVTijGU-7fKgIxlGuBXin-kR1KM18GkLnh5rcIPQqfG8TaTeHQt5SeS3QSKX9Asqe_mhbxdlAA5pNuy1UOCy_rEvJQssPleWEZXmJXssVloIgK4iVKkWxnAsAfrDE8yF1_dKG4N6i_eoHCuIPU4CzFJ_E5d22ax2YFfwD97ekixS-Em_H1FMPjBsSxNjIZTiqJ4jsgVpKyjmrqAvPT)

In 1988, I made it to America with only $100 in my pocket, which I borrowed, along with a $1,200 loan from my sponsor. I spoke very little English. In the 33 years since I have enjoyed living in this great country. I received a graduate degree, got married, raised three children, started my own business, and was naturalized as a U.S. citizen in 1995.

Fast forward to today: I've spoken out against Communism and Socialism appearing on Fox News, Tucker Carlson Tonight, Fox Business, Newsmax, Timcast, Huckabee TV, John Stossel, Joe Pags Show, Gothix TV, Shawn Ryan Show, Epoch Times TV, and Glenn Beck Radio. [](http://links.eaglecoalition.com/u/click?_t=e3c9a4cac7f248a39c2a3d920479a441&_m=86ba012b906c4cecaed732d9e585974b&_e=oWlrVfAW3oGSsKLgXDofeHrUx2alsDaKjqu9b56KliFprZV0v4W8qqKwqRGysOtRUK7cMVTX9qWabfI6tFK7M77tq-2PNM1P-S5_HNN5j0ypy4oLdljmvnbs25UNX0UOG4gcrWkM7V9fEZEKJl1GflUxHD_jmcgqrL8e3lGdd4e45ilW3o9gg_whMu78N2L4pPR1ugoTKGwGacft3It4fohsmYoXeuGhqCND92FDPdrbiVOVTijGU-7fKgIxlGuBXin-kR1KM18GkLnh5rcIPWnkIuqnaQaBRJfAc3EOdPgurFqLJAenNTLhW7uhFAgDyeIoubNB3MSeO-myHQW2tgUjZMN4jM5LosD6bDEVwlpph4EynIpJnP6tRUA7GNXf_Uu0fxRsHAT7c1Yrmd0WrkntxDZA-ZzpzEFCFPvmCvRt9kwE7Er2eEGhvZ667K7k)

I've authored opinion articles for The Epoch Times, Town Hall, National Review, Union Leader, Concord Monitor, and Granite Grok.

_And here's where the death threats from Beijing started: when I decided to run for Congress._

The Democrats don't want my story to reach the ears of my fellow Americans because they hope to enact their Socialist Agenda.

But more importantly, you and I cannot afford to let the woke liberal elite plunge the America we know and love any further down the dark path of Communism and trample on our God-given rights.

**[Please, will you stand with me and make a special donation of $25, $50, or $100 to stand with me?](http://links.eaglecoalition.com/u/click?_t=e3c9a4cac7f248a39c2a3d920479a441&_m=86ba012b906c4cecaed732d9e585974b&_e=oWlrVfAW3oGSsKLgXDofeHrUx2alsDaKjqu9b56KliFprZV0v4W8qqKwqRGysOtRUK7cMVTX9qWabfI6tFK7M77tq-2PNM1P-S5_HNN5j0ypy4oLdljmvnbs25UNX0UOG4gcrWkM7V9fEZEKJl1GflUxHD_jmcgqrL8e3lGdd4e45ilW3o9gg_whMu78N2L4pPR1ugoTKGwGacft3It4fohsmYoXeuGhqCND92FDPdrbiVOVTijGU-7fKgIxlGuBXin-kR1KM18GkLnh5rcIPfai-8GU0N0FHXBcsYpaSSncETOTl-mftIm8aVwlYCFElXERaV-sTaNi2N85ufYnk-pJQz2Y5Mv5z5XWqS-jtfXUkpMrzUHyKd7h9BV47PDk78V5XS5pZVVzB0-5UF77p6ZD5MVpQ48G_hgSMS8exA4OAiVA_VlPARqpDTVN690k)**

_Believe me. I'm not fear-mongering when I say you cannot imagine the horrors of Socialism and Communism. It is evil._

**[That's why I need you to stand with me and preserve the freedoms and values of our American heritage.](http://links.eaglecoalition.com/u/click?_t=e3c9a4cac7f248a39c2a3d920479a441&_m=86ba012b906c4cecaed732d9e585974b&_e=oWlrVfAW3oGSsKLgXDofeHrUx2alsDaKjqu9b56KliFprZV0v4W8qqKwqRGysOtRUK7cMVTX9qWabfI6tFK7M77tq-2PNM1P-S5_HNN5j0ypy4oLdljmvnbs25UNX0UOG4gcrWkM7V9fEZEKJl1GflUxHD_jmcgqrL8e3lGdd4e45ilW3o9gg_whMu78N2L4pPR1ugoTKGwGacft3It4fohsmYoXeuGhqCND92FDPdrbiVOVTijGU-7fKgIxlGuBXin-kR1KM18GkLnh5rcIPXtyPptozyaGzYaD3sU_O0VN0p1X_H2m0Cq5BfS0U7Br_vI-uEqUeim43_7gIbzUlMtspoqVAqWs_nfoC9RJWW6v-Pb03OE2r5KJ3vfhCihDS_aF9TrRTkAs8Vq2kR6Wy708FHlweXjkgrHHrR9-sqB3k_isPSlk1sn4xgsZ1I9q)**

For freedom,
Lily Tang Williams

**[P.S. Even if all you can afford is $5-- I will use every penny wisely in my campaign to defeat my liberal opponent who has been a rubber stamp for Biden's America-Last agenda. We can win this together.](http://links.eaglecoalition.com/u/click?_t=e3c9a4cac7f248a39c2a3d920479a441&_m=86ba012b906c4cecaed732d9e585974b&_e=oWlrVfAW3oGSsKLgXDofeHrUx2alsDaKjqu9b56KliFprZV0v4W8qqKwqRGysOtRUK7cMVTX9qWabfI6tFK7M77tq-2PNM1P-S5_HNN5j0ypy4oLdljmvnbs25UNX0UOG4gcrWkM7V9fEZEKJl1GflUxHD_jmcgqrL8e3lGdd4e45ilW3o9gg_whMu78N2L4pPR1ugoTKGwGacft3It4fohsmYoXeuGhqCND92FDPdrbiVOVTijGU-7fKgIxlGuBXin-kR1KM18GkLnh5rcIPbMMp5pHavqxGWV3qveTMC3LCAO4080y1HUR3bLadbY4YFUwqiuHCVvNkmY7PnMJsNQQpW1p6udu5ILi9vVKcJtjtnLTEHuZYxiw7CD2krQGlA6RpQEWO-D9jf_B3Ika7J_f_ZliX2a89pbVGm50LIdyUeVqX5J72DDb8_qmHDm0)**

| _I fear that the country I love is becoming like the country I left. That's why I am running for Congress.

_It's time for the majority to speak up and defend our country from the radical left and keep the American Dream alive for our children_._

| | | In just a few short weeks, Donald Trump will learn his sentence for his 34 convictions. And whether he goes to prison or is allowed to remain free while on probation, one thing is clear: [**Donald Trump must take drug tests as part of his sentence.**](https://default.salsalabs.org/T7b214c91-f425-4025-aaaa-bdc061b52248/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9) Many other felons are ordered to take drug tests, and there is no reason why Trump should be given special treatment. Recently, the University of California in Los Angeles (UCLA) blocked me from speaking to their students about Hamas' reign of terror through a Young America's Foundation (YAF) lecture. **Instead, they took every available action to block me from speaking and to prevent their conservative students from exercising their First Amendment rights to freedom of speech and assembly. **

**YAF is suing UCLA and will take them to court so that students can hear the truth about Hamas --the truth that their school is fighting to keep from them. **

But they can't do this alone. UCLA has vast resources and teams of lawyers preparing to defend their excuse for shutting down a conservative lecture on campus.

**Will you give $50 right now to stand with the conservative students of UCLA and fight back?** We are looking for 76 Americans to step forward today with a gift to protect conservative free speech. **And** **every dollar you give will fuel our fight to ensure that students on EVERY campus can learn the truth about Israel, Hamas, and the freedoms that make America great. **

How do you respond to horrid bigotry, especially when it's in response to condemning documented racism? **Let 's Address This **in a new issue of "**Hate Mail of the Weak**."
I periodically share this more personal side of my advocacy for human rights because it is important to me that you, my gracious supporters, see what I see. Apologies in advance for the vulgar language in the screen shots below.
[Upgrade to paid](https://substack..8IvRxJtJchssZTwtCm8iTmYCWB5DxRXn_pKHiG8mU3Q?&utm_medium=email&utm_source=subscribe-widget&utm_content=145583074)
**It started when I posted these two tweets.** I was frustrated at the recent decision by the South Carolina Department of Education to remove AP African American Studies as an elective. Yes, [they really did](https://substack.com/redirect/58e4630c-b607-4ce5-b041-99c0cf11b5cc?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg).
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/68411441-4d40-4869-91bd-9c57ba1d74f0?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
I followed up with another tweet pointing out the contemporary double standard of removing AP African American studies but keeping AP European History.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/79e8d33e-808e-4163-a076-95c92e11f4dd?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
**Both tweets gained popularity, ultimately gaining over 7500 retweets and 20,000 likes.** That drew the attention of racists, who unleashed grotesque bigotry in response to my tweets. The first one, classic Islamophobia.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/806f4008-5bf1-4389-8435-deb37c550957?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
Next, Islamophobia with a side of geographical ignorance and anti-immigrant bigotry.
[Upgrade to paid](https://substack..8IvRxJtJchssZTwtCm8iTmYCWB5DxRXn_pKHiG8mU3Q?&utm_medium=email&utm_source=subscribe-widget&utm_content=145583074)
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/c882d07e-b417-4011-a42c-3d21e1c4a004?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
Indeed, not only is my birth country of Pakistan in South Asia, not the Middle East, this is a good opportunity to remind everyone that the largest Muslim majority country in the world is Indonesia--which is in neither South Asia nor in the Middle East.
The next bit of hate was remarkably comprehensive. It infused Islamophobia, anti-Arab hate, anti-immigrant hate, anti-Black hate, and apparently anti-Hindu hate with the reference to the "Quickie Mart" and its Hindu owner Apu, from The Simpsons--and with a pretty clear call to violence and fighting. (Note, none of these were actually banned by Twitter).
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/75ca7289-8fe0-4e74-a2e0-019d2a6a4c54?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
And finally, dehumanizing racism.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/2650e4e7-2b7f-4314-a9f4-6567e96fba67?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
There is so much to unpack here.
**First, let me reemphasize my appreciation to each of you for supporting my work and advocacy.** Whether you subscribe for free or at $5/mo, your support to keep building is critical because, as you can see, these social media platforms are going full blown Nazi.
[Upgrade to paid](https://substack..8IvRxJtJchssZTwtCm8iTmYCWB5DxRXn_pKHiG8mU3Q?&utm_medium=email&utm_source=subscribe-widget&utm_content=145583074)
**Second, I emphasize again I want each of you to see how the most common response to condemning racism, is more racism.** This is done to maintain the status quo of racism and demonize anyone working to change that status quo. This is why it isn't enough to be not racist, but we must be actively anti-racist to counter this hate and vitriol.
**Third and finally, that means we respond by speaking up loudly. We cannot sit silent, but must continue to speak out.** As I've written before we do this when we tell our stories and share our stories. We do this by investing our time and resources to elevate people doing the work and building that more just and compassionate future. You have my promise to always speak up and uphold justice above all else, period. Let us continue to demand that more humane and just future for this generation and the next.
_**Are you in?**_

The first one, classic Islamophobia. | | ---|---|--- Next, Islamophobia with a side of geographical ignorance and anti-immigrant bigotry. | | ---|---|--- Indeed, not only is my birth country of Pakistan in South Asia, not the Middle East, this is a good opportunity to remind everyone that the largest Muslim majority country in the world is Indonesia--which is in neither South Asia nor in the Middle East. The next bit of hate was remarkably comprehensive. It infused Islamophobia, anti-Arab hate, anti-immigrant hate, anti-Black hate, and apparently anti-Hindu hate with the reference to the "Quickie Mart" and its Hindu owner Apu, from The Simpsons--and with a pretty clear call to violence and fighting. (Note, none of these were actually banned by Twitter). | | ---|---|--- And finally, dehumanizing racism. | | ---|---|--- There is so much to unpack here. First, let me reemphasize my appreciation to each of you for supporting my work and advocacy. Whether you subscribe for free or at $5/mo, your support to keep building is critical because, as you can see, these social media platforms are going full blown Nazi. Second, I emphasize again I want each of you to see how the most common response to condemning racism, is more racism. This is done to maintain the status quo of racism and demonize anyone working to change that status quo. This is why it isn't enough to be not racist, but we must be actively anti-racist to counter this hate and vitriol. Third and finally, that means we respond by speaking up loudly. We cannot sit silent, but must continue to speak out. As I've written before we do this when we tell our stories and share our stories. We do this by investing our time and resources to elevate people doing the work and building that more just and compassionate future. You have my promise to always speak up and uphold justice above all else, period. Let us continue to demand that more humane and just future for this generation and the next. Are you in? name: Elissa Slotkin
subject: Trump’s coming back to Michigan... here’s what it means
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY ELISSA SLOTKIN FOR MICHIGAN
body:
# [](https://act.elissaslotkin.org/go/188?t=1&akid=1527%2E135344%2EmnH2pF)

Friend --
In 2020, Donald Trump made more visits to Michigan than almost any other state in the country.
On Saturday, he is coming back for his 6th visit in less than a year.
Last time Trump was here, he spewed a litany of lies and name-calling. He called me a "far left liberal lunatic," said that I am "not respected," and that I am "very big for China."
He went on a wild rant about how the 2020 election was "rigged" -- riling up his supporters with the kind of rhetoric that led to the insurrection at the Capitol and will have unknown consequences if he loses again in the fall.
This time, he will rally his base at a far-right conference and, on the same day, host a roundtable event at a Black church -- a signal that his campaign is focused on winning over Black voters in Detroit. It’s clear that Trump knows that he can’t win the presidency without winning Michigan – and he’s going to keep coming back to win over new voters and secure the state in November.
But beyond what this visit will do for Trump’s campaign, let me break down how it will impact our Senate race.
There is no doubt Trump's supporters are as fired up as ever before after his guilty verdict. So this trip will mean more fundraising in Michigan for Trump and Republicans, new exposure for them to Black voters in Detroit, but also more volunteers flooding into campaign offices around the state.
These are the kind of things we have to factor in when putting together a plan for victory. So when Trump and the Republicans do more, we have to match them.
And in a race as close as ours, we just can't afford to fall behind. That is one of the reasons we launched our television ads so early, because our potential opponents went on the air in their primary, and the increased Republican enthusiasm means we have to be communicating with undecided voters early.
But we can't do any of that without the financial support of people who care about the outcome of this race.
[**So if keeping this Senate seat blue in November and defeating Trump in Michigan seems worth $3 today, I'm asking you to make that donation to my campaign. It's the perfect time ahead of Trump's visit.**](https://act.elissaslotkin.org/go/9?c0=ebs-em-june24.nyVfY7&refcode=em240613-1-sa&t=2&akid=1527%2E135344%2EmnH2pF)

subject: Dark money, SCOTUS, and Big Oil: It's all connected
body:
The big climate case you might not know about
| | | | [](https://actnow.evergreenaction.com/s/2619441/87SdQ4wZ) |
---|---|---
---
| Hi there,

The Supreme Court is about to deliver the Big Oil-backed Koch network a big win later this month—**here's what you need to know and what we can do about it.**

The **Chevron doctrine** (also called Chevron deference) has been used for decades, directing courts to defer to the experts at federal agencies when interpreting complex or unclear laws.

Now, the Supreme Court is about to release a ruling that could kill or limit this commonsense practice.

And **this has a huge impact on climate** and many other issues you may care about. It'll allow rightwing, climate-denying judges to step in with their own legal interpretations, no matter what the experts at agencies like the Environmental Protection Agency (EPA) say. |
---
[LEARN MORE](https://actnow.evergreenaction.com/s/2619442/87SdQ4wZ)
---
---
| **How we got here :** This case has Big Oil's fingerprints on it all the way through. They helped Donald Trump stack the court with a bunch of corrupt justices, brought the sham case being used to overturn Chevron, paid for the lawyers arguing the case, and are close to their goal of undermining EPA and other agencies' ability to do their job.

**Where we must go :** There is a way we can take back the court and advance democracy and climate action. [We dive deeper in our latest blog.](https://actnow.evergreenaction.com/s/2619443/87SdQ4wZ)

This web of dark money and power used the Supreme Court to shift power away from technical experts to themselves—corporate interests.

**It's time we—the public—fight back.**[**Read our latest to find out how.**](https://actnow.evergreenaction.com/s/2619444/87SdQ4wZ)

Onward, |
---
| | |
---
### Craig Segall
Vice President

# **Colin Allred**
---
| | | |
---
| | | | **FIRSTNAME** : I'm a fourth-generation Texan who was raised in Dallas by a single mom. My mother taught in public schools and sometimes even worked an extra job to get by. Thanks to her, my teachers and coaches, and the good folks at our local YMCA, I went on to play football for Baylor and in the NFL before becoming a civil rights lawyer. **Then I ran for Congress to serve the community that raised me.** I'm running for Senate because I don't want my story to be the exception. I want all kids, no matter where they're from or what they're facing, to have what they need to achieve their dreams. **Will you chip in to help me defeat Ted Cruz and give Texas families the senator we deserve? →**
---
| [Donate Now](http://click.nodemleftbehind.com/click/gpnv-2tofq3-ds68os-kyd76rh9/)
---
My very first vote in Congress was to expand the Affordable Care Act and make health care more accessible for all Americans. **_Ted Cruz once spent 21 hours speaking out against the ACA on the Senate floor._** Last year, I was proud to be a part of passing a historic infrastructure bill that will bring $35 billion to Texas over the next five years. I also helped pass the CHIPS and Science Act, which is bringing high-tech manufacturing to our state. Ted Cruz voted against both of these **_bipartisan_** bills. **_Ted Cruz would rather deny Texans vital investments we need than reach across the aisle._** He's one of the most divisive legislators in Congress and has spent his whole career pitting people against each other. I have a very different record of bringing people together – in fact, I was just named the most bipartisan member of the Texas delegation. **That's the kind of leader I'll be in the Senate, and if you agree Texans deserve better than Ted Cruz's selfish extremism,**[**I hope you'll chip in on my campaign today. We need to raise $45,000 a day to compete with Cruz and his special interest allies, so please: Split a donation between me and No Dem Left Behind before midnight to help me fire Ted Cruz →**](http://click.nodemleftbehind.com/click/gpnv-2tofq3-ds68ot-kyd76rh0/)

We’ve set high goals this month — it’s an official FEC fundraising deadline month, and after it hits we are legally required to report our numbers. You better believe that everyone — Kari Lake, Trump’s campaign, the press — will be watching the report we release.
#

Peter, this is not the news we hoped to be sharing today.
June 15th marks the halfway point to the end of the month, and we wanted to be quite a bit further along to our goals by now. As it stands, we’re less than 30% of the way there. With the way our fundraising has dropped off lately, we’re not projecting to hit our goals for the month.
That’s devastating news for us, because this is an official FEC deadline month. We’re legally required to file a public report that shows every dollar we raised and every donation we received over the past three months.
At a time when we need to show strength, to show that we can win in Arizona and stop Kari Lake and Donald Trump in their tracks, it’s a terrible time to come up short.
These goals aren’t arbitrary, and when we miss them it presents a major opportunity for our opponents. A weak report could invite millions of dollars more in attack ads, and that could really hurt us. Bad.
We have to hit these goals to win this race.
So, as we kick off our mid-month fundraising drive, please:

name: Texas Organizing Project
subject: Ready for Juneteenth & announcing a TOP promotion / Estamos listos para el Dia de la Emancipación en Junio y anunciamos una promoción en TOP
body:
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/TSM/TSMTO/1/45640/images/PNG%202023%20TOP%20Newsletter%20Header.png]
Lea el boletín en español abajo [#Español]
Creating brighter futures and building community power in San Antonio
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/TSM/TSMTO/1/45640/images/MAC%20Bexar%20County%20TOP%20group%20shot.jpg]
Join TOP and San Antonio allies Saturday, June 22 from 11 a.m. - 2 p.m., for a FREE event at the Barbara Jordan Center (2803 E. Commerce St.) dedicated to providing resources, information, and support for individuals seeking expungements to clear their criminal records.
Our Right2Justice team is partnering with Easy Expunctions to guide applicants through the process, offering insights, assistance, and potential opportunity to have your record cleared.
Attendees will gain valuable info and also a sense of community, support, as well as a place to get involved in our fight for mass liberation. Don't miss this opportunity to take a significant step toward a brighter future for yourself or a loved one. Register today and let us help you navigate your path toward expungement.
REGISTER HERE! [https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLScfN9OcDAVx2RV37t4ucGGYx4TI2HEhHm1pmwf8DY3nqyex0A/viewform]
Celebrating Juneteenth with a special film screening and speaker
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/TSM/TSMTO/1/45640/images/Newsletter%20-%20TEXAS%20USA%20screenshot.jpg]
TOP and Houston Justice on Saturday, June 22 at 2:30 p.m. will host a special Juneteenth event featuring the screening of the documentary TEXAS, USA [https://www.texasusafilm.com/] .
Bring your family and friends to see for yourselves how the future of democracy in the U.S. hinges on our movement's mission to end the right-wing political stranglehold on our state. The documentary features BlackTOP's 2022 midterm election get-out-the-vote program , which made history as the largest single investment in Black voters across Texas EVER, reaching over 1.4 million Black Texans.
After the screening, Terrance "TK" Koontz, TOP’s Culture and Organizational Development Director, will share his compelling life journey to becoming an organizer. TK will discuss the significance of and his dedication to his work with TOP.
RSVP to the documentary screening here [https://secure.ngpvan.com/hpIqtGLu_kCD_qFrnuHebw2] .
Meet TOP's new Political Director
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/TSM/TSMTO/1/45640/images/David%20Villalobos.jpg]
David Villalobos, longtime TOP organizer, is taking his talents to the TOP's Political Team where he will now serve as TOP's next Political Director!
Over the course of the last eight years as a TOP staffer, David has sharpened his skills as a community organizer — from his first organizing campaign against bad landlords and greedy developers, fighting FOR West Dallas residents to be able to stay in their homes, to most recently working to end mass incarceration — our movement and TOP are that much closer because of his relentless, impassioned efforts.
A political animal, David's first foray into politics at TOP was in 2018, when he served as Dallas County GOTV Director to win the DA's race between Faith Johnson and John Creuzot. David built a critical bridge between the 2018 political work he drove and TOP's Dallas County Right2Justice campaign. Since then, David has maintained a consistent connection to our political work — running the field operation in the 2022, historic Black voter engagement program and most recently co-managing TOP PAC's 2024 primary election get-out-the-vote work in Harris county — capstoned by the ouster of ex-DA Kim Ogg.
We can always count on David to show up — full stop. And he shows up with fire in his belly and enough energy to propel us all when the going gets tough. His political analysis is steeped in organizing. Join us in congratulating David on his promotion as TOP's Political Director!
TOP Tip: Take the 2024 Power Up Harris County Survey
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/TSM/TSMTO/1/45640/images/Power%20Up%20Harris%20County.png]
The Environmental Protection Agency (EPA) in April awarded Harris County nearly $250 million for solar energy projects focused in working-class communities. [https://houstonlanding.org/epa-awards-harris-county-and-partners-nearly-250-million-for-solar-energy-projects/] TOP is a proud member of the Power Up Harris County coalition and is excited about how this grant money can positively transform life for Black and Latino families of Harris County for years to come. Take the 2024 Power Up Survey to have your voice heard, if you're a Harris County resident. [https://survey.alchemer.com/s3/7719784/bc101a28c261]
Español
Creando futuros más brillantes y construyendo poder comunitario en San Antonio
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/TSM/TSMTO/1/45640/images/MAC%20Bexar%20County%20TOP%20group%20shot.jpg]
Únase a los aliados de TOP y San Antonio el sábado 22 de junio de 11 a. m. a 2 p. m. para un evento GRATUITO en el Centro Barbara Jordan (2803 E. Commerce St.) dedicado a brindar recursos, información y apoyo a personas que buscan eliminar sus antecedentes penales.
Nuestro equipo de Right 2 Justice se está asociando con Easy Expunctions para guiar a los solicitantes a través del proceso, ofreciendo información, asistencia y oportunidades potenciales para que se borre su historial.
Los asistentes obtendrán información valiosa y también un sentido de comunidad, apoyo y un lugar para involucrarse en nuestra lucha por la liberación masiva. No pierda esta oportunidad de dar un paso importante hacia un futuro mejor para usted o un ser querido. Regístrese hoy y permítanos ayudarle a recorrer su camino hacia la eliminación de antecedentes penales.
¡REGISTRATE AQUÍ! [https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLScfN9OcDAVx2RV37t4ucGGYx4TI2HEhHm1pmwf8DY3nqyex0A/viewform]
Celebramos el Juneteenth con una proyección de película especial y un orador
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/TSM/TSMTO/1/45640/images/Newsletter%20-%20TEXAS%20USA%20screenshot.jpg]
TOP y Houston Justice el Sábado 22 de Junio a las 2:30 p.m. organizará un evento especial el Juneteenth con la proyección del documental TEXAS, USA [https://www.texasusafilm.com/] .
Traiga a sus familiares y amigos para que vean por sí mismos cómo el futuro de la democracia en los EE. UU. depende de la misión de nuestro movimiento de poner fin al dominio político de derecha sobre nuestro estado. El documental presenta el programa de promoción del voto para las elecciones de mitad de período del 2022 de BlackTOP , que hizo historia como la mayor inversión individual en votantes Negros en todo Texas, llegando a más de 1.4 millones de Tejanos Negros.
Después de la proyección, Terrance "TK" Koontz, director de cultura y desarrollo organizacional de TOP, compartirá su apasionante viaje de vida para convertirse en organizador. TK hablará sobre la importancia y la dedicación de su trabajo con TOP.
Confirma tu asistencia a la proyección del documental aquí. [https://secure.ngpvan.com/hpIqtGLu_kCD_qFrnuHebw2]
Te presentamos al nuevo Director de Política de TOP
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/TSM/TSMTO/1/45640/images/David%20Villalobos.jpg]
¡David Villalobos, organizador de TOP desde hace mucho tiempo, está llevando su talento al Equipo Político de TOP, donde ahora se desempeñará como el próximo Director Político de TOP!
En el transcurso de los últimos ocho años como miembro del personal de TOP, David ha perfeccionado sus habilidades como organizador comunitario, desde su primera campaña de organización contra los malos propietarios y los desarrolladores codiciosos, luchando PARA que los residentes del oeste de Dallas puedan permanecer en sus hogares, hasta trabajar más recientemente para poner fin al encarcelamiento masivo: nuestro movimiento y TOP están mucho más cerca gracias a sus esfuerzos incansables y apasionados.
Un animal político, la primera incursión de David en la política en TOP fue en 2018, cuando se desempeñó como director de GOTV del condado de Dallas para ganar la carrera del fiscal del distrito entre Faith Johnson y John Creuzot. David construyó un puente fundamental entre el trabajo político que impulsó en 2018 y la campaña Right 2 Justice del condado de Dallas de TOP. Desde entonces, David ha mantenido una conexión constante con nuestro trabajo político: dirigiendo la operación de campo en el histórico programa de participación de votantes negros de 2022 y, más recientemente, coadministrando el trabajo de promoción del voto en las elecciones primarias de 2024 de TOP PAC en el condado de Harris — coronado por el derrocamiento del ex fiscal del distrito Kim Ogg.
Siempre podemos contar con la presencia de David, punto. Y aparece con fuego en el estómago y suficiente energía para impulsarnos a todos cuando las cosas se ponen difíciles. Su análisis político está impregnado de organización. ¡Únase a nosotros para felicitar a David por su ascenso como Director Político de TOP!
Consejos de TOP: Llena la Encuesta Power Up 2024 para el condado de Harris
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/TSM/TSMTO/1/45640/images/Power%20Up%20Harris%20County.png]
La Agencia de Protección Ambiental (EPA) otorgó esta semana al condado de Harris casi $250 millones para proyectos de energía solar enfocados en comunidades de clase trabajadora [https://houstonlanding.org/epa-awards-harris-county-and-partners-nearly-250-million-for-solar-energy-projects/] . TOP es un miembro orgulloso de la coalición Power Up Harris County y está entusiasmada con la forma en que este dinero de la subvención puede transformar positivamente la vida de las familias negras y latinas del condado de Harris en los años que vienen. Completa la Encuesta Power Up 2024 para que se escuche tu voz, si eres residente del condado de Harris. [https://survey.alchemer.com/s3/7719784/bc101a28c261]

Did you hear the news? Michigan Senate Republican Leader Aric Nesbitt and Kent County Prosecutor Chris Becker are on Team Hudson!

Leader Nesbitt and Prosecutor Becker join a list of strong conservative leaders here in the district and across our great state, who know our campaign is the best to beat Hillary Scholten in November.

That's why I am very honored to add my name to the Hudson Team. I think Paul Hudson will be a great public servant for West Michigan and I am excited to see him in Washington working on our behalf." - Michigan Senate Republican Leader Aric Nesbitt

# Ending Political Games

Peter:
Far too often, the halls of Congress are marked by partisan discord and unproductive debates, leaving important issues unresolved and the voices of everyday Americans unheard.
I believe good leadership means understanding the real needs of our communities, not playing political games.
**When I have the honor of serving in Congress** , rest assured, I won't play political games—I'll be the type who listens attentively to the needs of our communities.
By talking openly and working together, we can find solutions to our biggest problems and create an environment of open communication, ensuring that every constituent's perspective is valued.
**We CAN forge a path toward a brighter future for all Americans.**

name: Common Sense Club
subject: Eliminate NJ Residency Requirements
body:
Peter, In New Jersey, our communities are facing critical shortages in essential services—corrections, local police, teachers
|
---
| Peter, In New Jersey, our communities are facing critical shortages in essential services—corrections, local police, teachers, nurses, and more.**It's increasingly difficult to find qualified professionals to fill these vital roles, largely due to New Jersey's soaring cost of living and restrictive employment policies.**
**Why This Matters:**
New Jersey has led the nation in out-migration for the past five years. A significant barrier contributing to this exodus is the residency requirement for state workers and teachers, which mandates they live in New Jersey. This not only limits our ability to recruit top talent but also places unnecessary burdens on those wanting to serve.

---
|
---
Even the New Jersey Education Association (NJEA), with whom we rarely agree, acknowledges the detrimental impact of these residency requirements on our ability to address the teacher shortage. It's a rare moment of agreement that highlights a universal truth: **_change is necessary._**

---
| **What We Propose:** Instead of mandating where our teachers and state workers must live, we should focus on making New Jersey a place they desire to call home. We need policies that attract and retain, not repel. The real discussion should not be about enforcing residency but about fostering an environment where valuable professionals are eager to move here and stay. **The Common Sense Approach:** At the Common Sense Club, we believe in practical, sensible policies that support the backbone of our state—the hardworking individuals in public service roles. It's time to eliminate the residency requirement and advocate for broader reforms that make New Jersey affordable and attractive. **Take Action:** This isn't just about one policy change; it's about reforming a system that's become too restrictive and out of touch with the needs of its people. If you haven't already, [**join the Common Sense Club today**](https://xtz223.keap-link004.com/v2/click/1d2c0eb8131df403d714276c66b3e518/eJyNkE0LgkAURf_LW1vWaBDuIiQGzUXUOgZ95ZSOw_jMTPzvTR-0Kmh9zz2P-3ogVEIRzyCAK90Y88ABg6nUEhUtK0UifaZs5k-9qQOFVOeVqRoNQf-1_AGeLW_uO0CdRotsN4tlxJPVPuZJZEktjL3xn8efsI8nXC94DMPwU4ylpPBi3TUEZBp8LMqkXUU7U1g-J9J14Lpt245PlVSU40Eec2IT5o_TqnSxFLIYPSJrE1qjyt6viLB7OYc7IZNm8Q==) and help us fight for the policies that will restore and protect the core values of our great state.

[Join the Common Sense Club now](https://xtz223.keap-link004.com/v2/click/162e0c6202852f7ed7526f84833c4251/eJyNkMsOgjAQRf9l1ghYMDHsCDGmAV0YXZsGRqlCacogPsK_Wx9xpYnre-6Z3LkBoRKKeAERnOnKWAAOGMyllqgoaRSJ_JmySTgOxg5UUh3npuk0RLev5Q_wbAVT3wG6aLTIehUnKV_OtxlfppbUwtgb_3lCn308s0XMMxiGn2KsJc1O1t1CRKbDx6JC2lW0MZXlSyLdRp7X9717aKSiEndyXxLzWejmTe1hLWQ1ekTWJrRGVbxfkeLl5RzuHjNm7Q==) and be a part of meaningful change. name: Dr. Ben Carson
subject: Can I get your thoughts on religious liberty in America?
body:
http://paracom.paramountcommunication.com/p/vWPx5FpWN0

ACI - Religious Liberty Survey

I am fearful that legal persecution will intensify
against Americans holding to faith-based values
http://paracom.paramountcommunication.com/p/oWPx5FpWN0

Fellow
American,

There is
a very concerning trend occurring in our country that has me
worried for Americans who hold to biblical & faith-based values.

After the
Respect for Marriage Act was passed by a bi-partisan effort and
signed into law, I am fearful that legal persecution will only
intensify against Americans holding to faith-based values and who
wish to conduct their lives according to their faith.

Are you
concerned that America is abandoning a basic tenet of our
founding-Religious Liberty?

In
addition to the passing of the Respect for Marriage Act, numerous
examples over the past decade have concerned me: KENNEDY v.
BREMERTON SCHOOL DISTRICT, MASTERPIECE CAKESHOP v. COLORADO CIVIL
RIGHTS COMMISSION, and 303 CREATIVE v. ELENIS are just a few
examples of legal persecution against Americans holding to
faith-based values who wish to conduct their lives according to
their faith.

Furthermore, an amendment to the Respect for Marriage Act,
brought forth by Senator Mike Lee, prohibiting the Federal
Government from retaliating against schools, businesses, and
organizations because of their religious beliefs about same-sex
marriage failed.

This has
the potential to only intensify legal persecution against
individuals, businesses, churches, and nonprofits holding to
faith-based values.

The
American Cornerstone Institute is a non-profit that I founded to
preserve and promote the cornerstones that laid the foundation
for the greatest nation the world has ever seen: Faith, Liberty,
Community, and Life.

Whether
it is a football coach losing his job for praying at midfield
after a game, or a baker being sued for not wanting to bake a
cake that violates his religious values, are you concerned as I
am with the increase in legal persecution against Americans who
wish to conduct their lives according to their faith?

Please
share your thoughts in this quick 2-minute survey concerning
religious liberty in America.
http://paracom.paramountcommunication.com/ct/63287603:WPx5FpWN0:m:3:2532013465:36D33ACE7BEC1237CA3B9769721A4C12:r

Thank you
for your consideration.

Regards,

Dr. Ben
Carson
Founder &
Chairman American Cornerstone Institute

Your
donation to ACI helps us to focus on our mission of promoting and
preserving individual and religious liberty, helping our
country's most vulnerable find new hope, and developing methods
to decrease the federal government's role in society and to
improve efficiency to best serve ALL our nation's citizens.

Fellow Conservative,

On Sunday, I debated my Democratic opponent, Jon Tester, and the outcome of our tete-a-tete was straightforward: it’s time for a change in Washington. The type of change I’m talking about is generational, transformative, and substantial.

This debate made clear that while Tester has spent the last 18 years in Washington talking about ‘fighting’ for voters, our problems keep worsening as American families face skyrocketing price increases in food, housing, and energy.

This debate made clear that while Tester has spent 18 years cultivating relationships with powerful D.C. lobbyists, Montanans continue to be subject to a wide-open border that allows illegal immigrants to invade our country and bring crime and drugs into our communities.

**[I’m asking for your financial support today.
