name: Alexandria Ocasio-Cortez
subject: We must stand up undeterred
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Alexandria Ocasio-Cortez for Congress
body:
#
This year, AIPAC is coming to New York State in a way they have never before.
I want to be very clear that AIPAC — the American Israel Public Affairs Committee — is not representative or in alignment with the views of the vast majority of Americans, of Democrats, and especially generationally, many in the Jewish community.
They seek to artificially conflate some of the most conservative and war-hawk stances with bad faith accusations that criticism of the Netanyahu Administration or how Gazans are treated is somehow anti-semitic.
**We must stand up undeterred.**
Jamaal Bowman has a very serious primary challenge that is largely financed by AIPAC. They’re raising significant resources from, and are financed by, Republicans. **They endorse Republicans who supported the January 6th attacks.**
It’s so important to understand that the threat to democracy — both that Netanyahu represents in Israel and that Trump represents in the United States — are being supported by many of the individuals that support AIPAC as well.
This is a question of democracy. **This is a question of making sure that New York State is not torn up by the racist attacks that AIPAC engages in.**
**AIPAC has spent over $10 million in attack ads against Jamaal in less than 5 weeks, and they’re not slowing down.** [The New York primary election is in 12 days. Will you split a $2 contribution today between our campaigns — $1 for each team — to power our movement? 6 swing seats run through NY, and we need to preserve each one to win back the House of Representatives.](https://act.ocasiocortez.com/go/14659?c0=aoc-email-20240613-bowman.pQYcgE&refcode=em20240613-6630-P_FND_ANO_MIS&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1&akid=6630%2E2526796%2EWbKJkZ) **[Contribute $2](https://act.ocasiocortez.com/go/14659?c0=aoc-email-20240613-bowman.pQYcgE&refcode=em20240613-6630-P_FND_ANO_MIS&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=2&akid=6630%2E2526796%2EWbKJkZ)**
---
If, and when, we win big, what we tell the rest of the Congress is that AIPAC is nothing to be afraid of.
For the first time in modern American politics, conditioning aid to Israel is becoming a mainstream conversation in D.C. That has never happened before.
**And it’s happening because of the support, activism, and organizing of people like you.**
Thank you,
Alexandria

Hello,

I’ve been working to understand and tell the story of America through film for nearly 50 years. Moments like the Civil War, the Great Depression, the First and Second World Wars, and the COVID-19 pandemic are pivotal to that story – and I believe the 2024 election will be another such moment.
**We need to meet this moment in our nation’s history by helping reelect Sen. Jacky Rosen in the most critical race of this cycle.** **_[Will you join me in making a contribution so Jacky can spread her message to voters as the general election begins?](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/86848365/479221953/-1278658170?amounts=250,100,50,25,5&refcode=jtk3974-fr-nd&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNDAvMS84ODI5OCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJlYjQxZDUwMC1kMTI5LWVmMTEtODZkMi02MDQ1YmRkOWUwOTYiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=O6ve_qHaN9H1M92pshRSPB0gNaWFcc6phGCWHX3AB_Y=)_**

That’s especially true now that _The Cook Political Report_ is calling Nevada the "most perilous” swing state for Democrats and calling Jacky’s chances of winning a “Toss Up” – all while GOP dark money groups are continuing to pour millions into Nevada to tip the scales in their favor.
**We cannot afford for Jacky to lose; our democracy cannot afford for Jacky to lose. But to compete against the GOP’s dark money and win in Nevada, we need your help now so Jacky can spread her message to undecided voters.**
**_[So please, friend, join me and folks across the country by giving $5 or more now to help Jacky protect our Senate majority, our fundamental freedoms, and our democracy.](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/86848366/479221954/-1278658170?amounts=250,100,50,25,5&refcode=jtk3974-fr-nd&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNDAvMS84ODI5OCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJlYjQxZDUwMC1kMTI5LWVmMTEtODZkMi02MDQ1YmRkOWUwOTYiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=O6ve_qHaN9H1M92pshRSPB0gNaWFcc6phGCWHX3AB_Y=) _**

Dear Peter,
This is a critical moment.
As you may know, Robert F. Kennedy Jr.'s campaign is currently facing significant challenges to secure a place on the ballot in Nevada.
RFK Jr. URGENTLY needs your support to ensure that every American's voice can be heard in this pivotal election.
[Team Kennedy is filing a lawsuit against Nevada Secretary of State Francisco Aguilar, demanding fair and equal access to the ballot.](https://www.kennedy24.com/donate?e=d33e868971601c1c714cfe0555abd394&utm_source=joinkennedy&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=nevada_lawsuit_6_13_24_nd1&n=3) The state's restrictive and undemocratic policies are designed to hinder independent candidates, like RFK Jr., from participating in the electoral process.
[Support Kennedy](https://www.kennedy24.com/donate?e=d33e868971601c1c714cfe0555abd394&utm_source=joinkennedy&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=nevada_lawsuit_6_13_24_nd1&n=4)
As RFK noted, “We are fighting for the fundamental right of the American people to have choices in their elections. Nevada's policies undermine this right and threaten the very core of our democratic values.”
The fight for ballot access is not just about one state; it’s about ensuring a fair and democratic process nationwide. This lawsuit sets a precedent for other states and reinforces the principle that every candidate should have a fair opportunity to present their vision to the voters.
| | **"We are fighting for the fundamental right of the American people"**
---
—Robert F. Kennedy Jr.
_Your support is essential in this battle._ Legal battles like this are incredibly costly and time-consuming, but they are necessary to uphold the principles of democracy.
By contributing to Team Kennedy, you are helping us cover the legal fees to fight a two-party political machine that has endless resources.
Join us in defending democracy and ensuring that RFK Jr. has the opportunity to present his platform to the people of Nevada and across the nation. Your contribution, no matter the size, makes a significant impact.

body:
https://www.takingthehillpac.com/ [https://www.takingthehillpac.com/]
Friend - BLUF - was hoping you could read/share my Military Times OpEd published today and this quick tv clip. For my generation of veterans that came of age in the aftermath of the terror attacks on Sept. 11, 2001, and subsequently fought in the longest wars in American history, there is a signature injury that has impacted nearly three in ten of us — post-traumatic stress disorder, or PTSD.
PTSD is not just a medical diagnosis but a poignant symbol of a collective, enduring struggle. While we’ve seen resources and treatments provided for PTSD increase as well as a broader acceptance for those impacted by this injury, we’ve also seen these men and women viewed as though they’re broken.
Veterans who embody the ethos of post-traumatic growth — the positive psychological change experienced as a result of overcoming highly challenging and stressful life situations — push back against that “broken” narrative. I urge you to mark today June 13th as National Post-Traumatic Growth Day with other members in our military veteran community.
We have seen examples of post-traumatic growth throughout history, where significant adversity can spark substantial progress and change. Since our nation’s founding, waves of American veterans have demonstrated how they’ve become incredible civic assets after their military service. From George Washington to Dwight D. Eisenhower, John McCain and Colin Powell, these veterans became icons of American statesmanship.
John F. Kennedy was once asked what actions led him to become a war hero, which launched his career in public service. “It was involuntary – they sank my boat,” he said. My post-traumatic growth occurred in the same vein. I returned from an Iraq deployment with the 82nd Airborne Division’s Falcon Brigade in 2004 with the burden of 19 paratroopers killed in action. So I appreciate your support financially, online, and always with action on trying to make a difference. Please share and keep up the good fight! -Patrick

We’ve been racking our brains trying to think of a way to convince you to donate to Ruben Gallego’s U.S. Senate campaign in Arizona. We decided that the best way is to be honest with you.
#

Peter,
We’ve been racking our brains trying to think of a way to convince you to donate to Ruben Gallego’s U.S. Senate campaign in Arizona. We decided that the best way is to be honest with you.
So look. It would be one thing if Kari Lake was just a Republican.
**But she is more than that. She is a Trump Republican, the “MAGA Queen.”**
It would be one thing if she supported Trump, but recognized that he had lost the 2020 election fair and square.
**But Kari Lake has actively called for Republicans in Congress to void the 2020 election and get Trump back in the White House.**
It would be one thing if she accepted the insurrection at the Capitol on January 6th was one of the darkest days in the history of our country.
**But Kari Lake still, to this day, drives the lies and conspiracies that caused that insurrection. She defends those insurrectionists, praises them, and undermines our democracy.**
Kari Lake is the Republican frontrunner for Senate in Arizona, and that... that is genuinely ridiculous. Sorry to be so blunt, but it’s true.
And the worst part is she’s probably raising millions of dollars as we speak after Trump’s guilty verdict. With that money, with that support, she could win.
We can’t let that happen.

We need to talk about Louisiana, Peter. After Black Louisianans spent years and years fighting for equal representation, the state's congressional map was finally compliant with the Voting Rights Act. The fair maps movement was proud to support their efforts. But anti-democratic extremists immediately tried to undo this victory for democracy by filing a lawsuit to try to throw out the newly approved map ahead of the 2024 election. And even though they ultimately failed at the Supreme Court, they still got a federal court to rule in their favor along the way — and the case is still ongoing. **Every hard-fought victory voters earn will stay under attack. clean_body: Every victory will be under attack | We need to talk about Louisiana, Peter. After Black Louisianans spent years and years fighting for equal representation, the state's congressional map was finally compliant with the Voting Rights Act. The fair maps movement was proud to support their efforts. But anti-democratic extremists immediately tried to undo this victory for democracy by filing a lawsuit to try to throw out the newly approved map ahead of the 2024 election. And even though they ultimately failed at the Supreme Court, they still got a federal court to rule in their favor along the way — and the case is still ongoing. name: Katie Porter
subject: Americans deserve a Congress that works for them—not for special interests or a politician’s personal profit.
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Truth to Power PAC
body:
# [](https://act.katieporter.com/go/9?t=1&akid=38909%2E3422442%2EDQrG6Z)
Derek,
I just introduced five key bills to help Congress work more effectively for the American people and curb the influence of special interests in our government.
Americans deserve a Congress that works for them—not for special interests or a politician’s personal profit.
**[Will you add your name today to become a grassroots co-sponsor of the five pieces of legislation I just introduced?](https://act.katieporter.com/signup/ttp-em-20240613/?source=em20240613-38909&akid=38909%2E3422442%2EDQrG6Z)**
[Sign On](https://act.katieporter.com/signup/ttp-em-20240613/?source=em20240613-38909&akid=38909%2E3422442%2EDQrG6Z)
Here’s a quick rundown of the five pieces of legislation I just introduced:
1) The _Legislative Proxy and Absence Accommodation Resolution_ will allow Members to once again vote by proxy in the case of illness or another unavoidable absence, keeping Congress running and giving Americans the representation we deserve.
2) The _Majority Rule Resolution_ ends the filibuster, which has prevented Congress from passing legislation that is broadly popular with a majority of the American people.
3) The _Congressional Bipartisan Seating Resolution_ would set in stone a bipartisan recommendation to alternate seating of Members’ party affiliation during committee hearings. This will foster a more collaborative working environment between both parties.
4) The _Lobbying Disclosure Modernization Act_ would finally consolidate information about who is lobbying in Congress into one accessible platform for public viewing. This would increase transparency and trust.
5) The _Block the Revolving Door Act_ would institute a two-year ban on lobbying for former Members of Congress and other high-level government employees.
Thank you,
Katie Porter
[Sign On](https://act.katieporter.com/signup/ttp-em-20240613/?source=em20240613-38909&akid=38909%2E3422442%2EDQrG6Z)

| Peter,

We are only **a few weeks **away from being one month closer to the election, so allow me to take a few minutes of your time to explain just how important it is that we flip the House blue.

If Republicans hold onto their majority, _**California WILL be impacted:**_
* **Harsher immigration laws and practices** that will deeply impact migrant families, their livelihoods, our massive agricultural industry supported by thousands of hardworking temporary farmers, and consequently our community and economy

* **Massive Social Security cuts and raising the retirement age** , which will severely impact about 570,000 people in CA-38

* **Denying the right to an abortion** and making access to all forms of reproductive care difficult

* **Voting rights stripped away** , an attempt to discriminately silence voters of color to wrongfully give Republicans the upper hand in elections

* **Few restrictions on corporate polluters and disregard for clean energy** , consequently impacting future generations and their quality of life

FROM: A proud Democrat
Subject: I stand with you. **_Dear DA Alvin Bragg and Special Counsel Jack Smith,_**

Thank you for all your incredible work holding Donald Trump accountable for his many treasonous crimes!

Despite relentless MAGA attacks and threats, you’ve stood strong in defense of our democracy. I’m so grateful for your leadership!

But now, Trump’s minions are doubling down to SILENCE you — delaying cases, launching baseless investigations, _and threatening IMPRISONMENT!_

**I REFUSE to let that happen, so I’m fighting to keep Trump out of the White House before it’s too late.**

Kennedy Jr. and guest John Boyd talk about the systemic discrimination and challenges black farmers face in America. Boyd shares his personal experiences with the USDA and the ongoing struggle for land and debt relief. He also criticizes the current administration for repealing important legislation without offering alternative solutions and calls for systemic change to address these longstanding issues.**Key Points:**
* Boyd experienced loan denials while white farmers received preferential treatment
* Promises of land and debt relief for Black farmers remain unfulfilled
* Increasing ownership of agricultural land by billionaires and foreign entities threatens food security and sovereignty.

Kennedy Jr.'s campaign faces potential exclusion from CNN's upcoming June 27 presidential debate due to shifting criteria. subject: Breaking down the two major SCOTUS rulings today
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Jill Stein for President 2024
body:
We need a radical overhaul of the Supreme Court.

| | | [ ](https://www.jillstein2024.com/?e=e813143e1dc0d3b0ffcb007ffe357333&utm_source=jillsteinforpresident&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=scotus_update&n=1)
---
Peter

Two major Supreme Court rulings were handed down today – the first on abortion rights and the second on labor rights.

It’s a mixture of good news and bad, for now. Let’s talk about what happened and where we go from here.

**First, in a unanimous decision, the court temporarily halted attempts by extremist, anti-abortion groups from blocking distribution of the medication mifepristone – one of the two drugs used in safe, at-home medical abortions.

** Mifepristone has other medical uses as well, including treatment following a miscarriage to prevent sepsis, and to treat other complex reproductive health issues.

Had the Supreme Court sided with the anti-abortion groups today, it would have meant blocking mail-order access to this medication even in states where abortion is legal and protected.

_But here’s the catch.

_ While today’s ruling is a victory for abortion rights and bodily autonomy, the fight is not over. The conservative justices sent a clear message that they will hear the case again and rule differently if these groups bring a better case with “the right plaintiff.”

**Lest we forget: The only reason we are living through this nightmare, fighting for the right to control our own bodies again, is because Democrats chose to spend the last 50 years treating bodily autonomy as a fundraising gimmick instead of a fundamental civil and human right.

** Even in the wake of the _Dobbs_ decision, Democrats had the opportunity to pass abortion protections into law while they controlled both chambers of Congress and the White House. And Biden has considerable power under the Executive Branch to protect abortion access.

**They choose not to use that power, because it’s easier to fundraise on fear than to deliver results.

[As your president, I will leverage every tool at my disposal to safeguard our human rights and secure your right to healthcare.](https://www.jillstein2024.com/donate?e=e813143e1dc0d3b0ffcb007ffe357333&utm_source=jillsteinforpresident&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=scotus_update&n=2)**
---
| [](https://www.jillstein2024.com/donate?e=e813143e1dc0d3b0ffcb007ffe357333&utm_source=jillsteinforpresident&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=scotus_update&n=3 "DONATE NOW") [DONATE NOW](https://www.jillstein2024.com/donate?e=e813143e1dc0d3b0ffcb007ffe357333&utm_source=jillsteinforpresident&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=scotus_update&n=3)
---
**In the second major case decided today, a**** _nearly unanimous_****court savagely undercut the authority of the National Labor Relations Board and ruled in favor of Starbucks in their union-busting case.

** The result will give corporate thugs like Starbucks and Amazon carte blanche to continue steamrolling employees attempting to assert their power and safeguard their rights through collective bargaining.

**Even the lone justice who dissented, Justice Ketanji Brown Jackson, concurred with the majority ruling but disagreed with a few specifics.

** Given the widespread reporting of corruption among the Supreme Court – with details of millions of dollars in lavish gifts, favorable insider stock deals, and unexplained income for their spouses – the naked bribery is there for all to see.

There is only one remedy to the cancer of corruption that currently infects our highest court: **We need a radical overhaul of the Supreme Court.

** There is entirely too much power vested in this oligarchy of nine – and no accountability. **As president I will DOUBLE the number of Supreme Court justices from 9 to 18** to better reflect the growth of our population and scope of our federal court system. I will also impose term limits of 18 years and stagger the term limits so that a new seat opens each year.

We will pass legislation requiring a two-thirds supermajority from the Supreme Court for all cases involving judicial review of federal laws.

Finally, to excise the corruption for good, we will establish a binding code of ethics for all Supreme Court justices so that they are held to the same standard – or higher – as any federal judge.

**Never again will a single president have the power to put an ideological lock on the court for a generation. And never again will justices have unchecked power to lord over everyday Americans or escape accountability for their corruption.

[Those are the checks and balances our founders envisioned and that modern society demands. With your contribution, we can make that vision a reality and liberate our government from this corrupt, tyrannical court.](https://www.jillstein2024.com/donate?e=e813143e1dc0d3b0ffcb007ffe357333&utm_source=jillsteinforpresident&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=scotus_update&n=4)**

---
You can read more about my plans to fight corruption at every level of our federal government at [**jillstein2024.com/platform**](https://www.jillstein2024.com/r?u=Qj32F8ZTIcBOzthgR25-gF2J_V8cRlHgwGIBI_1lcLQ0Ce7w_K4rbPSVLguxOifF&e=e813143e1dc0d3b0ffcb007ffe357333&utm_source=jillsteinforpresident&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=scotus_update&n=6).

Thank you for investing in this bold vision for our future, and for joining me in this fight.

In solidarity and gratitude,

Jill
